observations: Black Sony PlayStation 4 console, original 'fat' model.
The 'SONY' and 'PS4' logos are visible on the front of the unit in photo 0.
A blue inventory sticker is attached to the top right of the console with 'C/N: 4254' and other illegible text.
No controllers (pads), power cables, HDMI cables, or game discs/cases are shown in either photo.
The exterior of the console appears clean and free of major scratches or dents.

claims.evidence: No game discs or digital library screens are shown.
No controller is visible in the photos.
This title does not exist (FC 25 is the current release); likely a typo or misinformation.
The exterior casing in photo 0 and 1 appears well-maintained.
The warranty seals on the back of the console are not shown.
The receipt is mentioned but not pictured.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or could have a hardware fault (e.g., Blue Light of Death).
risks.proof: A video of the console booting to the home screen and a photo of the system information page.

risks.risk: The claimed controller may be missing, third-party, or have 'stick drift'.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the front and back of the controller.

risks.risk: The 10 games may be digital accounts (which can be reclaimed by the seller) rather than physical discs.
risks.proof: A photo of the physical game discs or cases.

risks.risk: The console may have been opened for repair or cleaning, potentially damaging internal components.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear of the console showing intact warranty stickers.

proof_requests: Photo of the controller and the 10 games mentioned.
Video of the console powered on and connected to a screen showing the 'System Information' menu.
Photo of the back of the console to check the warranty seals.
Photo of the UK receipt mentioned in the text.
response.reason: The seller claims to include a controller and 10 games, but the photos show only the console unit. Furthermore, the mention of 'FC 27' (a non-existent game) is a significant red flag. Without proof of the accessories and the console's working state, a reliable valuation is not possible.
